title: Representative evaluation set
summary: Cover routine tasks and failures that matter to your actual project.

sections.label: Cases
items: Ordinary positive outcomes and hard negative examples.
Missing evidence, unavailable tools, and permission denial.
Relevant source languages and domain boundary cases.
Correct abstention or escalation, not only successful completion.

sections.label: Held-out design
sections.text: Keep related document families and revisions together when separating development and evaluation material; near-duplicates can inflate results.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Each case has expected evidence and a reviewed outcome. The set represents important task classes rather than an arbitrary demonstration count.

sections.label: Workload sample versus probes
sections.text: Separate representative workload examples from diagnostic error probes. Report results separately; a small chosen set cannot guarantee production reliability.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
